25. Kernel, User Mode and System Calls

The kernel manages protected hardware and OS resources. Applications request kernel services
through system calls.
Kernel එක hardware සහ protected resources manage කරනවා. User mode application එක system
call එකක් හරහා OS service ඉල්ලනවා.
Reading a file requires the OS to check permissions and access data.

strace -e openat cat /etc/hostname
Expected result: Shows selected system calls and the hostname if permitted.

Q: Why separate user mode from kernel mode?
A: To limit the damage a faulty or malicious application can cause.
